definitions.flip_rate: share of rows whose argmax differs between at least two of the R rotations
definitions.pairwise_flip_rate: share of rows whose argmax differs between rotations r and s, per pair (r, s), and the mean over pairs
definitions.acc_single_rotation: accuracy of the argmax of rotation r alone
definitions.acc_averaged: accuracy of the argmax of the arithmetic mean of the R rotations (the `probs` field)
definitions.acc_majority: accuracy of the plurality vote over the R argmaxes; a three-way tie falls back to the averaged argmax
definitions.acc_oracle_any: share of rows where at least one rotation's argmax is the gold (an upper bound, not a method)
definitions.acc_all_rotations: share of rows where every rotation's argmax is the gold
definitions.confident_flips: flipped rows on which at least one rotation put max p > 0.9 on its answer
definitions.confident_both_ways: flipped rows on which two rotations each put max p > 0.9 on different answers
definitions.first_shown: option shown first (label A) in rotation r is canonical option r; win = that option is the rotation's argmax
definitions.position_shares: pooled over rotations x rows: share of wins at display position p versus share of gold labels at p
definitions.paired_first_vs_elsewhere: for the R options that are shown first in some rotation: mean probability and win rate when first versus in the other rotations, same rows
definitions.geometric_vs_arithmetic: rows where argmax of the mean log-probability (used for temperature scaling) differs from argmax of the mean probability
